description: Create an event in Apple Calendar. Use for appointments or calendar blocks, not reminders. Ask if the date or start time is missing.

params.name: start
params.description: Start time. Use ISO 8601 with a time zone offset for an exact time.

params.name: end
params.description: End time. Defaults to one hour later. Use ISO 8601 with a time zone offset for an exact time.

evals.utterance: Put dental cleaning on my calendar tomorrow at 9 for an hour
